# MemoryGraph upstream provenance

- Source: https://github.com/memory-graph/memory-graph
- Version: `v0.13.0`
- Git commit: `67fc4f97816aa75823ae2dd4eff49f150cc6f1da`
- License: MIT. The full license and original copyright notice are in `LICENSE` beside this file in the installed `lfw/vendor/memory-graph/` directory.
- Original copyright notice: Copyright (c) 2024 Claude Code Memory Contributors.

The development repository originally checked out this commit as a Git submodule. Its files now live in `lfw/vendor/memory-graph/` as ordinary files; the Git submodule metadata is not distributed. The upstream checkout had no local changes when it was moved. Recheck the source files and update this record if the distributed version or modifications change.

The distributed copy omits five upstream documentation images (`docs/html/favicon.svg`, `docs/html/logo-220.png`, and the three JPEG files in `docs/images/`). Their references were removed from the bundled README and HTML page. The runtime source and original MIT license remain included.
